fixture_name: Milltown Park toucan-crossing VRU conflicts — real Irish Stage 1 RSA incl. rejected recommendation (ABP 322160)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Insufficient shared-use width creating pedestrian–cyclist conflict risk at a toucan crossing approach is a substantive, classic preliminary-design-stage safety issue affecting geometry still open to change.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-IN-025 quote directly records the pivotal claim (limited space for bicycles/pedestrians near the Sandford Road crossing could lead to collisions); minor NE-vs-NW side-labeling drift does not detach the anchoring.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a PIARC-style safety_concern with no normative_basis_note, keeping the safety issue categorically distinct from any compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Names a specific action (widen) at a specific location (approach to the north western access), actionable at preliminary design; a target width or obstruction-relocation option would strengthen it further.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit subjects, with their interaction risk analyzed as the core harm, so VRU impact consideration is complete.
